title: 多智能体强化学习中的通信时机：基于信念分布与KL散度的门控机制
summary: 提出一种基于KL散度阈值的原则性通信门控方法，智能体仅在信念分布分歧大时通信。在Predator-Prey和MPE基准上评估，相比IC3Net等方法，在困难任务上性能更优且方差更小，并发现信念头本身也能改善协调。
summary_en: Proposes a principled gating mechanism for multi-agent RL communication based on KL divergence between belief distributions. Evaluated on Predator-Prey and MPE benchmarks, showing improved performance and lower variance on harder tasks, with belief head contributing to coordination.
